title: Guessing the gender of nouns
goal: By the end of this lesson you can guess the gender of most new nouns from their ending, know the main exceptions, and understand why you will hear 'une autobus' in Quebec while writing 'un autobus'.

body: Gender is not random: the ending of a noun predicts its gender correctly most of the time. When you meet a new word without an article, look at the last letters.
These rules have exceptions, so they help you guess, not replace learning. Still, they will be right far more often than a coin toss.
Nouns ending in *-age*, *-ment*, *-eau*, *-isme*, *-oir*, *-ier* and *-et* are usually masculine. So are most nouns ending in a consonant, days, months, seasons, languages and metric units.

head: Ending
Examples
rows: le fromage, le voyage, le garage
le bureau, le gâteau, le manteau
le soir, le miroir, le papier, le cahier

learn.tip: Exceptions in -age: la page, la plage, l'image, la cage, la nage, la rage.

body: Nouns ending in *-tion* / *-sion*, *-té*, *-ure*, *-ette*, *-ance* / *-ence*, *-ie*, *-ise* and *-ude* are usually feminine.
A final *-e* often (but not always) signals a feminine noun: *la porte*, *la table*, *la chaise*. Watch out for masculine words in -e: *le livre*, *le monde*, *le musée*, *le problème*.

head: Ending
Examples
rows: la question, la station, la télévision
la voiture, la culture, la confiture
la fourchette, la toilette, la bicyclette
la boulangerie, la pharmacie, la valise

learn.tip: Exceptions: le musée, le lycée, le café, l'été (m), le comité.

body: For people, gender usually follows the person: *un étudiant* / *une étudiante*, *un ami* / *une amie*. Many nouns just add *-e*. Some change more: *un acteur* / *une actrice*, *un boulanger* / *une boulangère*.
In Quebec, feminine job titles are standard and expected: *une professeure*, *une auteure*, *une ingénieure*. Quebec adopted these forms long before France.

Some masculine nouns that start with a vowel are made feminine in casual Quebec speech: *une autobus*, *une avion*, *une ascenseur*. Why? With *l'* and with liaison (*un‿autobus*), you cannot hear the gender, so speakers drift.
This is informal spoken usage. In writing and careful speech, these words stay masculine: *un autobus*, *un avion*, *un ascenseur*. Recognise the Quebec form, but write the standard.

quebec.intro: In casual Quebec speech, some masculine nouns starting with a vowel become feminine: une autobus, une avion. It's informal; in writing they stay masculine.

drills.why: la plage, la page, l'image, la cage are feminine.

drills.q: A noun ending in -tion is usually…
drills.why: la question, la station, la nation.

dialogue.en: Excuse me, I have a question.

dialogue.fr: L'autobus pour le musée, c'est ici?
dialogue.en: The bus to the museum, is it here?

dialogue.fr: Oui, mais l'autobus est en retard.
dialogue.en: Yes, but the bus is late.

dialogue.fr: Ah non! Le musée ferme à cinq heures.
dialogue.en: Oh no! The museum closes at five.

speak.prompt: Guess the gender aloud and add le or la: fromage, télévision, gâteau, liberté, voyage, culture.
speak.model: le fromage, la télévision, le gâteau, la liberté, le voyage, la culture

speak.prompt: Say what you are and what a friend is, using masculine and feminine forms.
speak.model: Je suis étudiant. Mon amie Julie est étudiante aussi.

speak.prompt: Say the bus is coming, first in standard French, then in casual Quebec style.
speak.model: Un autobus arrive. / Une autobus arrive.

write.prompt: Write 6 nouns you know with le or la, and next to each, the ending rule (or exception) that tells you the gender. Then write 2 sentences using them.
write.model: le fromage (-age), la question (-tion), le bureau (-eau), la santé (-té), la plage (exception), le musée (exception). Le fromage est bon. La plage est belle.

quiz.why: An exception to -eau: l'eau and la peau are feminine.

quiz.q: Why do Quebecers sometimes say 'une avion'?
options: Gender is hard to hear before a vowel, so it drifts
quiz.why: With l' and liaison, the gender of vowel-initial words is not audible.

quiz.q: In Quebec, the feminine of 'professeur' is usually written…
quiz.why: Quebec standard uses professeure, auteure, ingénieure.

quiz.q: Which word is an exception to 'final -e = feminine'?
quiz.why: le problème, le livre, le monde are masculine.

quiz.q: The best strategy for gender is to…
options: Guess from the ending and always learn the article
quiz.why: Endings help guess; the article confirms.
